verdict.rationale: Rive's docs cover every element of the story: timeline and keyframe animation with interpolation [rive-docs-3], interactivity that responds to input, scrolling and application state [rive-docs-4], and state machines advanced at runtime [rive-gh-1][rive-docs-10]. Variables come through data binding and view models [rive-docs-5][rive-docs-24], and scripting extends behavior beyond the built-in tools [rive-docs-6]. Rive also positions its output as the shipping product rather than a mockup [rive-docs-23]. Missing for 10: detailed docs on state-machine transitions and conditions, scroll effects shown beyond a one-line mention, and independent hands-on corroboration of these prototyping behaviors.
